newsitem.title: UK: Household retailers dragged lower by MFI.
newsitem.headline: Household retailers dragged lower by MFI.

text.p: Shares in household goods retailers such as Carpetright Plc and DFS Furniture Co Plc were hit on Tuesday by a surprisingly disappointing trade update from the MFI Furniture Group, traders said.
MFI said sales growth had slowed over the winter period and in the second half of the year. The company said it had not yet seen a sustained lift in demand in its marketplace.
Shares in DFS fell 16-1/2p to 595p on the news and Carpetright lost 20-1/2p to 601p.
Kingfisher Plc was also hit, to be down 9p at 683p, whilst Argos Plc fell 8-1/2p to 683p. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 4027
